initiatives: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME - MoFPI)
One District One Product (ODOP - DPIIT Ministry of Commerce & Industry)
State Specific ODOP Notifications (Biswa Bangla, UP ODOP, MP ODOP)
_metadata.research_notes: Ground-truth audited against DPIIT, MoFPI PMFME, and State Industries Department notifications. Bankura's notified ODOP is Terracotta Craft & Dokra (Bishnupur/Panchmura) and Baluchari Silk; dairy is supported under general rural agro schemes but is NOT Bankura's designated ODOP. | v2026.3: extended to all States/UTs from the DPIIT (2023) and MoFPI PMFME (2024) district lists. Newer districts created after June 2023 may be missing or listed under parent districts; verify against the live ODOP portal before statutory use. Source spelling typos corrected (e.g. Oleoresins, Raisin, Bentonite); 'Deogarh' under Jharkhand in the DPIIT list is entered as Deoghar.
sources: DPIIT - Products Identified under One District One Product Initiative (ODOP) as of 9 June 2023 (761 districts, 1,093 product rows, 36 States/UTs incl. West Bengal)
MoFPI PMFME - Revised List of ODOP for 35 States/UTs, 13.03.2024 (726 districts, food products; West Bengal has not notified a PMFME ODOP)
Curated entries carried over unchanged from registry v2026.2

data_tiers.curated: Hand-audited entry from v2026.2 (rich fields populated). Left untouched; official lists attached in dpiit_odop_products / pmfme_odop_product for cross-checking.
data_tiers.official_list_basic: Built from the DPIIT and MoFPI lists only. odop_product = DPIIT product(s); category and matching_sectors are keyword-derived from those product names; pmfme_eligible = district has an MoFPI-approved PMFME food ODOP. gem_category, cfc_available, raw_material_availability, rbi_psl_category are null and key_benefits is empty because no official source was used for them.
